lyrics:
[Intro: soft organ, slow bass, wordless group harmony]

[Hook: group in close harmony, sung]
Roll call at the gate, say them out loud
Everybody that we love who's gone ahead now
Call a name, hear a "present" from the cloud
Roll call at the gate, say them out loud

[Verse 1: rapid harmonised rap, two voices trading]
Uncle Ray, with the hat and the toothpick, present
Taught me how to tie a tie and never be a peasant
Miss Bea from the fourth grade, red pen, present
Said I'd be a writer when I couldn't spell a sentence
Little Dre from the building, gone at nineteen, present
Still got his jacket and I wear it for the blessing
Auntie with the peppermints in church on Sunday, present
Every name's a light, and I can see by the reflection

[Hook: group in close harmony, sung]
Roll call at the gate, say them out loud
Everybody that we love who's gone ahead now
Call a name, hear a "present" from the cloud
Roll call at the gate, say them out loud

[Verse 2: rapid harmonised rap, three voices]
Granddaddy with the garden and the radio, present
Coach who drove the van and never asked us for a penny
Cousin from the summer with the bike, I see you, present
Neighbor lady fed us when the fridge was looking empty
Said I wouldn't cry, and I'm a liar, I'm a mess
Got a list here longer than the ones I got left
But I say 'em and they're standing, and I say 'em and they're here
Say 'em every morning, say 'em every year

[Bridge: voices a cappella, slow]
And when it's my name
Somebody say it
Somebody say it out loud

[Final Hook: full group, choir, organ swelling]
Roll call at the gate, say them out loud
Everybody that we love who's gone ahead now
Call a name, hear a "present" from the cloud
Roll call at the gate, say them out loud

[Outro: organ, voices overlapping softly: "Present. Present."]
